title: Teams
summary: Admins: group people into teams for tasks, chat, checklists and news.

blocks.text: Teams are the groups that tasks, announcements and chat are sent to. Each team gets its own chat.

items: **Everyone** always contains every user, so its members can't be edited.
Other teams start empty: add the people who belong, and give the team a colour.
A task sent to a team can be done by anyone in it; the first one to finish closes it.
**Archive** a team you no longer use. It disappears from new assignments, and its history is kept.
